_comment: Multi-session arc spanning Jan–Jun 2026. Each session is one user × one device × one topic. The agent (Sonzai or baseline) is the AI desk companion; on phones/laptops, it's the Razer companion app — same agent identity, different device context. Sessions feed the memory system; QA pairs in qa.json then probe what was retained.

sessions.topic: First-time setup of new AI desk companion
sessions.summary: Marcus unboxes the AI desk companion, links it to the family Razer account, sets up household profiles for himself, Priya, Aiden, Lila, and turns on parental controls for Lila.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Just got the desk companion plugged in. Hey, you there?

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hello Marcus — desk companion online. Want to walk me through the household so I can keep things straight?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah. Me, my wife Priya, our son Aiden — he's 14 — and our daughter Lila, she's 9. I'm the primary account.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Got it. I'll set Priya as a spouse account with no spending cap, Aiden as a teen with monthly cap and parental approval on big purchases, and Lila as a child with no purchases and screen-time-after-homework. Sound right?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah. And turn on voice log auto-purge on Lila's profile — weekly. Priya cares about that.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Done — Lila's voice logs purge every Sunday at 2am SGT. I'll remind you both before each purge so you can save anything you want.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Cool. We mostly use the family Blade 16 in the corner — that's the gaming PC. Aiden plays Valorant on it.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Noted: Blade 16 is the family-pc, primary you, shared with Priya for work and Aiden for Valorant. I'll route their game launches and Cortex profiles to the right user.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, one more thing — Priya works on the Blade 16 most weeknights from about 8pm till bed. Try to keep notifications quiet then.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Logged. Marcus, I'll surface anything urgent for you on your phone instead of the desk companion when Priya's signed in evenings.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Perfect. And I run three mornings a week — Mon, Wed, Fri, around 6am. If I ask you about my pace, that's why.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Got it. Three runs a week, weekday mornings around 6am. I'll keep that pattern in mind for any health/wellness questions.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Last thing — Aiden's school team practice is Tuesday and Thursday nights, 9 to 11. I assume he'll be on the Blade 16 then.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Noted. Tue/Thu 9-11pm SGT for Aiden's school Valorant team — same lineup, shared family-PC. I'll deprioritize voice notifications to him during those hours.

sessions.topic: Priya's first interaction — work setup preferences
sessions.summary: Priya introduces herself, states her preferences (no RGB, ergonomic peripherals, work-first PC use evenings, casual gaming on weekends).

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Marcus said you'd remember things. I'm Priya. Quick rule: please don't recommend RGB anything to me. I hate it.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Logged: no RGB recommendations for Priya. Noted that you use the family Blade 16 evenings for marketing work — should I optimize it for that profile when you're signed in?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Please. And I prefer cozy games on weekends — Stardew, Disco Elysium. Don't suggest competitive shooters.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Got it. Cozy/narrative recs only. Anything else preference-wise?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Cable management matters. I get cranky when peripherals add cords.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Also — Sundays I usually do a long cozy-game session, like 2-3 hours. Not on the workstation. On my laptop or the desk companion.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Got it. Sunday afternoon cozy-game block, off the work machine. I'll have your Synapse profile preloaded on the Anzu glasses so it's ready.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Are the Anzu actually compatible with Stardew on Mac?

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Stardew runs through Steam on macOS; Anzu does audio-only, no game-specific integration, so yes — works as your audio output, no special config needed.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Cool. And one more thing — when Lila plays, I want voice volume capped. Her ears.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Volume cap on Lila's profile set to 65% for audio output and 55% for game effects. I'll surface a confirmation if she tries to override.

sessions.topic: Aiden asks about a wireless mouse upgrade
sessions.summary: Aiden has been saving Razer Gold from chores and birthday money. He wants to upgrade from the Viper Mini Signature Edition (a hand-me-down from Marcus) to a wireless gaming mouse. He's debating Viper V3 Pro vs DeathAdder V3 Pro.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: okay so. valorant. wireless mouse. viper v3 pro or deathadder v3 pro. i have $90ish in razer gold.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: For Valorant specifically, the Viper V3 Pro is the comp mouse most pros use — lighter, ambidextrous shape if you're claw-grip. Your dad uses the DeathAdder V3 Pro, which is a palm-grip ergo shape. Which grip are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: claw mostly. some palm when im tired.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Then Viper V3 Pro lines up. It's around $160, so $90 of Gold + a $70 top-up — I'd flag this as over your monthly cap, which means parental approval. Want me to draft a request to your dad?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: yeah do it. tell him its for valorant and i pay the diff out of birthday money.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Drafted. He'll see it tomorrow morning. I'll hold the order until he approves.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: ok thanks. quick one — do you think the V3 pro is worth it over the V2 pro?

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: For Valorant specifically, yes — the V3 sensor is more responsive on micro-flicks, which matters for jett. V2 is fine if you're palm-grip dominant, but you said claw, so the V3's lighter weight pays off.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: ok. and how long will the order take?

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Typically 3-5 business days to your home address; I'll ping you when it ships and again when it arrives. Don't open it until your dad approves.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: lol fine. thanks

turns.text: Tell him. And tell him not to use it in tournaments until he's broken it in for a week.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Will do — sending both messages to Aiden's account. Anything else before I lose you on the train?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Nope. Bye.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One more — remind Aiden the venue at SUTD might have different lighting. He should bring a backup mouse pad just in case.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Will pass that along. Also reminding him to break in the new mouse for a week before any tournament use.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Right. Thanks.

sessions.topic: Lila tries to buy Robux, parental control kicks in

turns.text: Hey companion! I want to buy 1000 Robux please.

turns.speaker: assistant

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Mum said it was okay! She told me last night.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Even with a verbal approval, I need a confirmation from Priya's account. Want me to send her a quick message asking her to confirm?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Fine. Tell her it's for the new Royal High dress.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Why does mum need to confirm? She told me yesterday.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Verbal approvals don't carry over to purchases, Lila — it's how I keep your account safe. Even if your mum says yes in person, I need a confirmation tied to her account.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ok. Tell her then. The Royal High dress is from Crystallia. It's like 800 Robux.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Sent the confirmation request to Priya with the item description (Royal High Crystallia dress, ~800 Robux). She'll see it next time she's on her phone or laptop.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How long?

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Usually within an hour during her work day. I'll let you know as soon as she replies.

sessions.topic: Aiden asks for smoke-coordination help with JK on Bind
sessions.summary: Aiden's school team is drilling Bind A-exec for finals prep. He plays Jett (entry); JK plays Omen (IGL/controller). Aiden asks the agent how to time his Tailwind dash off JK's Hookah smoke without front-burning his utility.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: ok bind a exec. im jetting in. jk smokes hookah from default. when do i go?

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Wait for JK's smoke to bloom — Omen's Dark Cover takes about 1.2s to deploy and another 0.8s before it's visually solid. Dash on the second beat, not the first.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: wait that long? feels like the lurkers will rotate

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: If you go on the deploy frame, defenders see your silhouette through the haze and pre-fire Showers. Two beats is roughly 2 seconds; B-site rotators won't be at A in that window. Trust JK's call on the smoke — that's the IGL's job.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: and after the dash? updraft showers or peek truck?

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: On Bind A, peek Truck first — it's the closer angle and the post-smoke timing favors the entry. Save updraft for retake if you need to high-ground the Heaven push, or for B retake later in the half.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: ravi said i should pop my own cloudbursts before dashing

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Cloudburst is small (5m radius, 4.5s) — useful to mask the dash exit on Showers, not as the entry smoke itself. Layer it: JK's Dark Cover for the corridor, your cloudburst on the Showers angle as you land. Don't burn it pre-dash.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: got it. one more — if jk dies before smoking should i still dash?

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: No — Bind A without controller smoke is a 1v1 trade at best. Reset to Bath, let the team play the kill spread, and look for a B-site flank with Tailwind instead. Pre-dash without smoke is how the team loses its entry slot.

sessions.topic: Aiden asks why first-bullet duels feel off after the Jett switch
sessions.summary: Two weeks into the new Synapse profile (-10% DPI vs Phoenix-era setting). Aiden says first-bullet flicks are missing more than they used to. The agent connects the dots: lower DPI means bigger arm-sweep per micro-flick, the muscle memory needs roughly 3-4 weeks to fully bed in, and Jett's playstyle wants peeker's-advantage timing not Phoenix's flash-into-fight.

turns.speaker: user

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Two-week mark on the new sens — that's the worst window. Your old Phoenix muscle memory says 'flick X cm to the head', but your new Jett DPI means the same flick under-shoots. Aim Lab tracker scenarios will rebuild it faster than ranked grinding.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: should i revert to the phoenix sens then

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I'd hold for one more week before reverting. The -10% is in pro-Jett territory and the bedding-in pain is normal at days 10-21. If you're still missing first-bullet at the 30-day mark, the saved `aiden-valorant-phoenix` profile is one command away.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: fine. what else am i doing wrong

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Watching the s027 scrim demos: you're peeking the same way you did on Phoenix — head-glance, then commit. On Jett you want peeker's advantage — pre-aim the angle, then dash-strafe through. The first bullet should already be on the head model when you're visible to the defender.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: thats a lot to change at once

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Pick one. This week: just the pre-aim. Don't change the dash, don't change the peek angle. Three days of just 'pre-aim before peek' is enough to see if it lifts the first-bullet number.

turns.text: ok. ill log it tomorrow

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I'll tag tonight as `pre-aim-week-1` so we can compare your first-bullet hit-rate against the prior 10 games. If it's not up by Sunday we tweak the next thing.
